meta.phase-name: Escape the Dungeon Level-Schema Runtime Integration

phase-summary.outcome: Escape the Dungeon now consumes the shared level-content payload through the runtime content-pack path, while browser and KAPLAY gameplay surfaces continue to use the active authored bundle.

file.description: Prefers authored level content and projects it into dungeon layouts for the current game loop.
Uses explicit pack-precedence rules so level-content overrides and old dungeon-layout overrides behave predictably.
Runs browser playthroughs against authored content-pack overrides.
Loads the active authored bundle into the docs-site game shell.

next.action: Use the shared level schema as the baseline for the later region-level gameplay expansion instead of reintroducing a parallel topology system.
